verses.html: A Psalm of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.text: A Psalm of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.title: A Psalm of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.
verses.titleHtml: A Psalm of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.

verses.html: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
verses.text: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

verses.html: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.text: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

verses.html: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.text: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

verses.html: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
verses.text: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

verses.html: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.text: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.html: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
verses.text: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

verses.html: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
verses.text: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

verses.html: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
verses.text: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

verses.html: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
verses.text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.

verses.html: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.text: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

verses.html: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?
verses.text: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

verses.html: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.text: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.html: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.text: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.html: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
verses.text: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

verses.html: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.text: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.html: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
verses.text: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

verses.html: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.text: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

verses.html: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
verses.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

verses.html: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
verses.text: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

verses.html: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
verses.text: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

verses.html: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
verses.text: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
